Original repeated bounds check cannot differ: the first in-range path makes no calls or bounds writes before this check; a successful original 0x4db6e0 grow normalizes lower/upper bound around the identical index, while failed growth faults at 0x4dc680. Checked original instructions at 0x468adf..0x468b7f and 0x4db6e0.

Only reachable after the second table grow returns failure; second grow is unreachable because the repeated bounds test cannot differ, and original growth failure itself faults reading address 4 at 0x4dc680 with EBP=0. Checked original disassembly and allocation diagnostic.
